about_the_game:
Cry of Monster is a 2D survival horror game with a pixel art style that immerses you in an experience filled with tension, mystery, and gore. You control a young woman in an abandoned city, searching for her best friend who vanished under unsettling circumstances. In this short game (1 hour), you must solve puzzles, execute mechanics, explore environments, and face grotesque monsters.

Main Features:

  • Engaging Story: Uncover the truth behind your friend's disappearance through an emotional narrative full of unexpected twists.

  • Survival and Puzzles: Use your wits to solve environmental puzzles and escape deadly traps while managing limited resources to survive.

  • Multiple Gore Deaths: Every mistake can lead to one of many brutal and visually striking deaths.

  • Pixel Art Style: Enjoy retro 2D art that blends nostalgia with an oppressive atmosphere, complemented by a haunting soundtrack and sound effects.

Will you find your friend and escape alive, or become prey to the unknown?

Warning: This game contains explicit gore content, including graphic violence and bloody deaths, which may not be suitable for all audiences.

content_descriptors.notes: Cry of Monster contains mature content focused on moderate violence and gore elements, presented in a retro pixel art style that heightens the horror atmosphere. Players will encounter combat scenes against deformed creatures, with depictions of blood and graphically intense deaths that occur when failing puzzles or being caught by enemies, reinforcing the tension of the survival horror experience. The narrative explores a dark story about failed scientific experiments, with an oppressive atmosphere and psychological horror elements that may be unsettling for some players. There are no depictions of sexual content, sexual abuse, non-consensual sex, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm in the game. However, the combination of violence, gore, and themes of human experimentation may not be suitable for all audiences, particularly those sensitive to blood or psychologically disturbing environments.

short_description: Everything fell apart. People started getting sick… not in a normal way. Now the city is desolate, and the only thing that matters is finding out if your best friend is still alive. You'll have to explore, run, hide, and face the contamination.
